items.t: Upwork to Present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
items.sum: PALO ALTO, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Upwork Inc. (Nasdaq: UPWK), the world’s human and AI-powered work marketplace, today announced that Chief Financial Officer Erica Gessert and Chief Business Officer Peter Sanborn will participate in a fireside chat at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale, AZ on Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 8:55 a.m. MT/7:55 a.m. PT. items.t: Upwork: New Products Grow, Core Business Shrinks
items.sum: Analyst rates Upwork a Hold as Q3 GSV and active clients each fell 10% year over year, with acquisition headwinds that could persist into H1 2027.

items.t: Why Upwork (UPWK) Is Getting Attention After Its Latest Update
items.sum: Upwork (UPWK) has just packed earnings, fresh guidance, a CFO succession plan, and a new Upwork Now hiring feature into a single update, giving investors several moving parts to assess. Against that backdrop, Upwork’s recent 30 day share price return of 17.73% and 90 day share price gain of 16.97% hint at building momentum.
